project_overview: This Vue.js project appears to be a web application centered around an examination management system. It utilizes multiple Vue components, likely organized around distinct features like exam forms, results, and user interactions. The dependency graph reveals a primary routing structure and component interactions, suggesting a modular design. The application's reliance on several Vue components indicates a potential need for careful state management to ensure data consistency across different views.

macro_trends.title: Potential Low-Level View Import
macro_trends.description: Component '1' (ApplicationServices.vue) and '11' (SelectedApplicationService.vue) both have route connections. This warrants investigation to ensure the application doesn't rely on low-level utility Vue components directly within high-level business logic components. This could lead to maintenance and scalability issues.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow begins with user interaction in 'ExamFormSubmission.vue' which may then update state or trigger other components. Data might be passed through 'Transactions.vue' for processing and ultimately displayed in 'ResultPage.vue' or 'viewMarksheet.vue'.  The dependencies between the components and the potential reliance on internal state management are key areas of concern.
